title: My cousin's wedding
instructions: Ayla kuzeninin düğününü anlatıyor. Yeri, kişi sayısını ve olanları takip et.

script.speaker: ayla
script.text: Last weekend, I went to my cousin Elif's wedding.

script.speaker: ayla
script.text: It was in a beautiful garden next to the sea.

script.speaker: ayla
script.text: There were about two hundred guests, and the music was fantastic.

script.speaker: ayla
script.text: I wore a long blue dress that I bought especially for the wedding.

script.speaker: ayla
script.text: We danced until two in the morning. My feet hurt the next day!
